import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel, GaussianModel, VoigtModel, LinearModel
df=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=df.shift_cm1.values; y=df.intensity.values
def fit(lo,hi,centers,label):
    m=(x>=lo)&(x<=hi); xx=x[m]; yy=y[m]
    mod=LinearModel(prefix='bg_')
    pars=mod.make_params(bg_slope=0, bg_intercept=np.median(yy))
    for i,c in enumerate(centers):
        v=VoigtModel(prefix=f'p{i}_')
        pars.update(v.make_params(center=c, amplitude=dict(value=(yy.max()-yy.min())*3,min=0), sigma=dict(value=2,min=0.3,max=20), gamma=dict(value=2,min=0.1, max=20)))
        mod=mod+v
    r=mod.fit(yy,pars,x=xx)
    print('==',label,'chi2red',round(r.redchi,1),'bic',round(r.bic,1))
    for i in range(len(centers)):
        c=r.params[f'p{i}_center']; s=r.params[f'p{i}_sigma']; g=r.params[f'p{i}_gamma']; A=r.params[f'p{i}_amplitude']
        fwhm=0.5346*2*g.value+np.sqrt(0.2166*(2*g.value)**2+(2.3548*s.value)**2)
        print(f'  center {c.value:.2f} +/- {c.stderr:.2f}  FWHM~{fwhm:.2f}  amp {A.value:.0f} +/- {A.stderr:.0f}')
    return r
r1=fit(335,372,[353],'E2g/2LA region 335-372 one Voigt')
r2=fit(405,428,[414],'A1g region 405-428')
r3=fit(500,540,[521],'Si region')
"

candidates.evidence: Two modes at 353.0 and 415.7 cm-1 (separation 62.6 cm-1) match the WS2 E2g^1 / A1g pair at 532 nm (literature ~356 and ~420 cm-1, separation ~64 cm-1).
